visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with extreme close-ups of golden-brown, crispy sliced pancakes filled with layers of minced meat and bright green scallions on a patterned plate. Yellow text appears at the bottom. (2) A male chef in a white uniform holding a plate of the food smiles and gestures towards the camera in a bright studio kitchen. (3) Hands in plastic gloves place minced meat into a glass bowl, adding ginger and spices with a metal spoon on a wooden tabletop. (4) A red tin of Bull Head Shallot Sauce is held up and its contents are scooped into the meat mixture. (5) The gloved hands thoroughly mix the meat and sauce until combined. (6) Two sheets of dough are rolled out with a white rolling pin on a silicone mat. (7) Chopped scallions are spread on one sheet, followed by the meat mixture, and then stacked and folded into a neat square package. (8) The folded pancake is placed into a black pan with oil and fried until the crust becomes golden and flaky. (9) The chef appears again, presenting the finished dish and pointing enthusiastically towards the product.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming accompanied by a light drum beat. A sharp 'whoosh' SFX signals a transition as a high-arousal male voice greets the audience with clear Mandarin articulation. (2) As the narrator describes the ingredients, the sound of a metal spoon clinking against a glass bowl and the subtle rustle of plastic gloves are heard. A 'sparkle' SFX plays when a brand is mentioned. (3) During the folding sequence, low-frequency thuds of a rolling pin and the sticky sound of dough being manipulated are audible, while the background music maintains a constant, energetic tempo. (4) A distinct, high-frequency sizzling SFX dominates the mix as the pancake hits the pan, layered with a 'ding' SFX emphasizing a key tip. (5) The video concludes with the narrator's tone becoming even more enthusiastic, ending with a final guitar flourish as the music fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Ingredient Intro -> Step-by-step Process -> Final Result -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to teach viewers how to make scallion meat pancakes easily at home while specifically promoting Bull Head Shallot Sauce as the key flavor enhancer. It uses a high-energy delivery and visual close-ups to make the cooking process look appealing and simple.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The chef explicitly identifies Bull Head Shallot Sauce as the 'key to elevating the meat filling' and features the product tin prominently in the center of the frame.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video is a typical fast-paced social media cooking ad. The combination of appetizing visuals, clear instructions, and a charismatic host makes it highly effective for engagement and product promotion.
